units.title: Definition of prior authorization
units.text: In this FAQ, prior authorization means a review of a prescribed medicine before the pharmacy fills it.
units.source_span: In this FAQ, prior authorization means a review of a prescribed medicine before the pharmacy fills it.

units.title: FAQ scope
units.text: The FAQ applies to prior authorization questions on medicines Harbor's pharmacy benefit covers for Medicare Advantage members. It does not decide medical-benefit drugs, it does not set visit costs, and it does not replace the member's plan document when that document prints a fee or a filing window this page leaves out.
units.source_span: The FAQ applies to prior authorization questions on medicines Harbor's pharmacy benefit covers for Medicare Advantage members. It does not decide medical-benefit drugs, it does not set visit costs, and it does not replace the member's plan document when that document prints a fee or a filing window this page leaves out.

units.title: Prescriber office calls in scope
units.text: Calls from prescriber offices are in scope when they reach the pharmacy queue.
units.source_span: Calls from prescriber offices are in scope when they reach the pharmacy queue.

units.title: Enter written request before starting PA
units.text: Start a prior authorization only after you enter the prescriber's written request in the intake tool.
units.source_span: Start a prior authorization only after you enter the prescriber's written request in the intake tool

units.title: No decision date promise before entry saved
units.text: Do not promise the member a decision date before the prescriber's written request entry is saved in the intake tool.
units.source_span: do not promise the member a decision date before that entry is saved.

units.title: Attach clinical notes and medicine list
units.text: Attach the prescriber's clinical notes and the member's current medicine list before you submit the request.
units.source_span: Attach the prescriber's clinical notes and the member's current medicine list before you submit the request.

units.title: Who may open a PA request
units.text: Only the prescriber may open a prior authorization request.
units.source_span: Only the prescriber may open a prior authorization request.

units.title: Checking PA status
units.text: Can I ask about the status of a prior authorization? Yes. Call the number on your member ID card and ask the advocate to read the status on the request.
units.source_span: Can I ask about the status of a prior authorization? Yes. Call the number on your member ID card and ask the advocate to read the status on the request.

units.title: Missing prescriber signature
units.text: When the prescriber signature is missing, hold the file at the desk and do not escalate to the specialty supervisor.
units.source_span: When the prescriber signature is missing, hold the file at the desk and do not escalate to the specialty supervisor.

units.title: Standard PA decision timeframe
units.text: A standard prior authorization decision is due 7 calendar days after Harbor receives a complete request. This figure is illustrative.
units.source_span: A standard prior authorization decision is due 7 calendar days after Harbor receives a complete request. This figure is illustrative.

units.title: Decision letter goes to prescriber
units.text: Tell the member that the decision letter goes to the prescriber office, and offer to explain that letter in plain words.
units.source_span: Tell the member that the decision letter goes to the prescriber office, and offer to explain that letter in plain words.

units.title: Peer-to-peer scheduling window not in FAQ
units.text: The number of days a prescriber has to schedule a peer-to-peer review after a denial is in the clinical operations memo. This FAQ does not state that number of days.
units.source_span: The number of days a prescriber has to schedule a peer-to-peer review after a denial is in the clinical operations memo. This FAQ does not state that number of days.

units.title: Portal decision summary timing
units.text: A summary of the prior authorization decision appears in the member portal within 3 business days. This figure is illustrative.
units.source_span: A summary of the prior authorization decision appears in the member portal within 3 business days. This figure is illustrative.

units.title: Specialty intake copay example
units.text: The illustrative specialty intake copay at a preferred network pharmacy is $65.
units.source_span: The illustrative specialty intake copay at a preferred network pharmacy is $65.

units.title: Appeal filing window
units.text: An appeal may be filed up to 60 calendar days after the date on the decision letter. This figure is illustrative.
units.source_span: An appeal may be filed up to 60 calendar days after the date on the decision letter. This figure is illustrative.

units.title: Recording an appeal
units.text: Record the appeal in the case file on the same day the member asks for it, and send the file to the appeals desk.
units.source_span: Record the appeal in the case file on the same day the member asks for it, and send the file to the appeals desk.

units.title: Who can request an appeal
units.text: Who can ask for an appeal? The member may ask, and so may a caregiver with an authorization on the account.
units.source_span: Who can ask for an appeal? The member may ask, and so may a caregiver with an authorization on the account.

units.title: Appeal fee on plan document
units.text: Any fee charged to file an appeal is printed on the member's plan document. This FAQ does not state a fee.
units.source_span: Any fee charged to file an appeal is printed on the member's plan document. This FAQ does not state a fee.

units.title: When to read clinical boundary script
units.text: Read the next block word for word when a member asks if the medicine is right for them.
units.source_span: Read the next block word for word when a member asks if the medicine is right for them.

units.title: Clinical boundary legal script
units.text: I cannot tell you whether this medicine is right for you. Your prescriber makes that decision. I can tell you the status of the request on your plan record today.
units.source_span: I cannot tell you whether this medicine is right for you. Your prescriber makes that decision. I can tell you the status of the request on your plan record today.

units.title: No medicine changes while PA pending
units.text: Do not tell the member to stop, start, or change a prescribed medicine while a prior authorization is pending.
units.source_span: Do not tell the member to stop, start, or change a prescribed medicine while a prior authorization is pending.

units.title: No dose or substitute recommendations
units.text: Do not recommend a dose, a substitute medicine, or a days' supply. Send clinical questions back to the prescriber.
units.source_span: Do not recommend a dose, a substitute medicine, or a days' supply. Send clinical questions back to the prescriber.
